landing.heroTitle: Receive and manage appointment requests online.

landing.featuresTitle: What ClinicSlotHub does for your practice
landing.feature1Desc: Keep all waiting patients in one place.
landing.feature2Desc: When a slot opens, suitable patients are prepared and can be notified via a secure link.
landing.feature3Desc: Identify cancelled appointments and quickly fill the gaps.

landing.trustSubtitle: ClinicSlotHub supports – decisions are always made by the practice.
landing.trustPoint1: No automatic message without approval from the practice.
landing.trustPoint2: Patient data stays minimal — only what an appointment request needs.
landing.trustPoint3: In standard mode, messages are prepared – not automatically sent.
landing.trustPoint4: No fake references. No invented user numbers.
landing.trialNote: Clinics can show available appointment options. Patients can choose a time and send a request.

landing.onlineBookingBullet1: Name, email, preferred time window and request reason
landing.onlineBookingBullet3: No automatic confirmation without clinic approval
landing.clinicsSubline: ClinicSlotHub helps you accept appointment requests online — your clinic stays in control.
landing.audienceSplitSubline: Practices and clinics manage appointments — patients request appointments. No patient registration, no payment on the website.
landing.audienceSplitProviderNote: Monthly SaaS access. Access only after review — no self sign-up.
landing.audienceSplitPatientNote: Request appointments easily online — no account and no login. The practice reviews and confirms every request.
landing.useCasesTitle: For many types of healthcare providers
landing.useCasesSubline: ClinicSlotHub supports medical practices, specialist practices, clinics, therapy and diagnostic providers, and other suitable healthcare organizations with structured appointment and request management. The areas below are examples — activation is always subject to review of the country, provider and legal requirements.

landing.providerWorkflow2: The practice decides what gets confirmed
landing.patientFlowLead: Submitting an appointment request should be clear and easy.
landing.providerFlowLead: Your front desk keeps full control over every request.

landing.safety2: Local legal and data-protection review is required before any live use with patient data.
landing.safety3: Availability is limited to selected markets and subject to review.

landing.sell6: Multilingual booking page for selected markets

landing.planClinicDesc: For clinics, health centers and multiple locations.
landing.faqSubtitle: Clear answers about how ClinicSlotHub works and who it is for.
landing.faq1A: Practices, clinics and healthcare centers. Patients do not pay on this website.
landing.faq2Q: Is ClinicSlotHub for urgent or acute cases?
landing.faq2A: No. ClinicSlotHub is not intended for urgent situations or clinical advice. For anything time-critical, contact your local care services directly.
landing.faq3A: No. The practice can review requests and confirm appointments manually.
landing.faq4A: ClinicSlotHub is intended only for selected international markets. Availability and legal review take place before activation.
landing.faq5Q: Can a practice go live immediately?
landing.faq5A: No. Activation follows a review of market, organization and legal requirements.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Answers to the most important questions about using ClinicSlotHub.
help.q1: Why does it say 'Prepared – provider not configured'?
help.a1: That is the free default mode. No real SMS or WhatsApp is sent. The link is only prepared.
help.q2: Are real SMS or WhatsApp messages sent?
help.a2: No, as long as MESSAGING_PROVIDER=none is set. SMS/WhatsApp can optionally be activated later via Twilio.
help.q3: Why is a patient not notified?
help.a3: Possible reasons: no consent, invalid phone number, or no provider configured.
help.a4: DRY RUN means test mode. No real message is sent.
help.a5: Contact support via the contact page or by email.
